name: sky desk
normative-structure: Whether the day's astrology and moon numbers reached #sky-desk (its own lane, never #weather-report -- that lane is climate/collapse/culture signal, a different beat entirely) as a precise infographic, and whether the prose explaining them and the day's lection reached it alongside, honestly reflecting whatever lenticule-science's Divination settlement and red-cup-engineering's Logical Inference Service Section actually returned -- is this office's own record, never a number redrawn by hand or a reading invented when a contracted service returned an honest absence.
theory-basis: lenticule-science's Divination settlement's own sign-reader office: 'what a sign-panel settles to... is this office's own record, never a persona's private hand-cast draft' -- sky-desk consumes that settled record rather than re-deriving or restyling it
red-cup-engineering's Logical Inference Service Section's own additive, already-generic section-level contract: sky-desk is a new consumer of an existing service, not a new team

its own #sky-desk channel lane, defined in @red-cup-engineering/turntide-islands-discord-platform/index.mts alongside the pre-existing #weather-report lane -- corrected 2026-07-18 after this office's first live post wrongly used #weather-report (a pre-existing, differently-scoped climate/collapse/culture-signal lane); the two wrongly-posted messages were deleted and #sky-desk was founded as this duty's own destination
unrealized: the deploy pipeline (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) does not yet splice divination's and red-cup-engineering's built code into the deployed tarball, and needs two new deploy-key repo secrets (DIVINATION_DEPLOY_KEY, RED_CUP_ENGINEERING_DEPLOY_KEY) that only a repository admin can create -- until both land, the daily pipeline is not live on a deployed server; realized instead as an hourly local cron entry (`0 * * * *`, this host's crontab, not itself a git-tracked record) invoking the idempotent-per-UTC-day dist/turntide-software-system/bin/daily-divination-report.mjs, logging to data/agency/daily-divination-report-cron.log

the RCL daily-reading table (lib/.../divination/src/lib/divining/src/liturgy/lectionary-data.mts) only covers June 2026 by hand-transcription; Vanderbilt's site blocks this package's own automated fetches, so dates past June settle no-entry-recorded with a note linking the real per-date source page rather than a fabricated citation -- extending the table requires manual transcription, the same method the existing June rows were built by

x-provenance.derived-from: user directive of 2026-07-18: stand up Turntide Islands' own settlement membrane to carry a daily divination report -- raw astrology/moon numbers infographic contracted from Divination, a companion text report (astrology, moon, and lection) prepared by red-cup-engineering's LISS, posted to #weather-report
